diagnosis: SignedAgreementDownloadView accepts a token signed with TimestampSigner containing only agreement_id. Because the signed payload does not bind the recipient's identity or organization, and the view fails to check request.user or company tenancy against agreement.organization, any recipient of a signed link can share it or reuse signed links across unintended parties to download private agreements.

GET /agreements/signed-view/?token=1092:1uF2eX:H8f... HTTP/1.1
Host: legal.enterprisegroup.com
Accept: application/json
